meaning.en: To form cliques and factions for selfish ends.
meaning.zh: 拉拢一些人，结成小集团。

examples.zh: 公司里有人拉帮结派，搞得人心涣散。
examples.en: Some people formed cliques in the company, sapping everyone's morale.

examples.zh: 班干部不能拉帮结派。
examples.en: Class monitors mustn't form little cliques.

examples.zh: 严禁领导干部拉帮结派。
examples.en: Officials are strictly forbidden to form factions.

natural: can't make head or tail of it

meaning.en: To be completely puzzled; unable to figure something out.
meaning.zh: 弄不清是怎么回事，莫名其妙。

equivalents: can't make head or tail of it

examples.zh: 他这番话让我摸不着头脑。
examples.en: I couldn't make head or tail of what he said.

examples.zh: 老师突然发火，同学们都摸不着头脑。
examples.en: The teacher suddenly lost his temper, and the class was baffled.

examples.zh: 这个说明书写得乱七八糟，看得人摸不着头脑。
examples.en: The manual is such a mess it leaves you scratching your head.

usage.en: Predicate, often 让人/叫人摸不着头脑; 摸不着 is said mō bu zháo. Short form of the xiehouyu 丈二和尚——摸不着头脑.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“让人摸不着头脑”。歇后语“丈二和尚——摸不着头脑”的后半。

meaning.en: Without any worries or cares.
meaning.zh: 没有一点忧愁和顾虑。

equivalents: without a care in the world

examples.zh: 孩子们在海边无忧无虑地玩耍。
examples.en: The children played on the beach without a care in the world.

examples.zh: 真怀念那段无忧无虑的童年时光。
examples.en: I really miss those carefree childhood days.

examples.zh: 退休后，他过上了无忧无虑的生活。
examples.en: After retiring he led a carefree life.

meaning.en: To wave one's arms and stamp one's feet — dancing with joy or excitement.
meaning.zh: 两手舞动，两脚跳动，形容高兴到了极点。

examples.zh: 听说考上了大学，他高兴得手舞足蹈。
examples.en: Hearing he'd got into university, he danced for joy.

examples.zh: 孩子们手舞足蹈地唱着歌。
examples.en: The children sang, waving their arms and jigging about.

examples.zh: 他讲起故事来手舞足蹈。
examples.en: He gestures wildly whenever he tells a story.

story.en: The Great Preface to the Book of Songs: when feeling is not fully expressed by singing, 'without knowing it the hands wave and the feet stamp' (不知手之舞之，足之蹈之也).
story.zh: 《诗大序》：“永歌之不足，不知手之舞之，足之蹈之也。”

date.en: Han dynasty, 2nd c. BC–1st c. AD

usage.en: Predicate, adverbial, or complement after 得.

meaning.en: Called for again and again; much-awaited before finally appearing.
meaning.zh: 形容再三催促、呼唤，多指人或事物经过很久才出现。

equivalents: finally sees the light of day

examples.zh: 这部电影千呼万唤始出来。
examples.en: After endless anticipation, the film was finally released.

examples.zh: 经过千呼万唤，新版手机终于上市了。
examples.en: After much clamour, the new phone has finally hit the shelves.

story.en: Bai Juyi describes the pipa player who, 'after a thousand calls and ten thousand summons, at last came out, still half hiding her face behind her pipa' (千呼万唤始出来，犹抱琵琶半遮面).
story.zh: 白居易《琵琶行》：“千呼万唤始出来，犹抱琵琶半遮面。”

usage.en: Usually in 千呼万唤始出来.

meaning.en: Each takes what they need.
meaning.zh: 各自拿取自己需要的东西。

examples.zh: 双方各取所需，合作得很愉快。
examples.en: Both sides got what they needed, and the partnership went smoothly.

examples.zh: 自助餐厅里，大家各取所需。
examples.en: At the buffet everyone helps themselves to what they want.

examples.zh: 这场婚姻不过是各取所需。
examples.en: The marriage was simply a convenient arrangement for both.

usage.en: Predicate; also the communist slogan 各尽所能，按需分配.

meaning.en: To be far ahead of everyone else.
meaning.zh: 远远地走在最前面。

examples.zh: 第一圈结束，他已遥遥领先。
examples.en: After the first lap he was already far out in front.

examples.zh: 这家公司的市场份额遥遥领先。
examples.en: This firm has a commanding lead in market share.

examples.zh: 她的成绩在全班遥遥领先。
examples.en: Her marks are streets ahead of the rest of the class.

meaning.en: No news at all; nothing heard.
meaning.zh: 一点消息也没有。

examples.zh: 他出国以后就杳无音信了。
examples.en: Not a word was heard from him after he went abroad.

examples.zh: 寄出的信件杳无音信。
examples.en: The letters I sent never got a reply.

examples.zh: 失散的亲人至今杳无音讯。
examples.en: There's still no news of the lost relatives.

meaning.en: First impressions dominate and colour later judgement.
meaning.zh: 先听进去的话或先得到的印象占了主导地位，以后不容易接受不同意见。

examples.zh: 别先入为主，等调查结果出来再说。
examples.en: Don't prejudge it — wait for the investigation.

examples.zh: 人们常常先入为主，以貌取人。
examples.en: People often go by first impressions and judge by appearances.

examples.zh: 这种先入为主的观念很难改变。
examples.en: Preconceived ideas like this are hard to shift.

story.en: Xifu Gong urged the emperor to weigh advice carefully and 'not take what was heard first as the master' (无以先入之语为主).
story.zh: 《汉书·息夫躬传》：“唯陛下观览古戒，反复参考，无以先入之语为主。”

meaning.en: Lying every which way in disorder.
meaning.zh: 形容纵横杂乱。

examples.zh: 地上横七竖八地躺着几个喝醉的人。
examples.en: Several drunk people were sprawled all over the floor.

examples.zh: 宿舍里鞋子横七竖八地摆着。
examples.en: Shoes were strewn every which way across the dorm.

examples.zh: 台风过后，街上的树倒得横七竖八。
examples.en: After the typhoon, fallen trees lay higgledy-piggledy across the street.

meaning.en: Extremely pained and indignant.
meaning.zh: 形容痛恨或伤心到了极点。

examples.zh: 看到文物被破坏，专家们痛心疾首。
examples.en: Experts were heartbroken to see the relics destroyed.

examples.zh: 他对自己当年的错误痛心疾首。
examples.en: He bitterly regrets his mistakes of those years.

examples.zh: 网友对这种浪费行为痛心疾首。
examples.en: Netizens deplored such waste.

story.en: In the Jin envoy's letter breaking off relations with Qin, the lords are said to be 'pained at heart and aching in the head' over Qin's perfidy (斯是用痛心疾首).
story.zh: 《左传·成公十三年》：“诸侯备闻此言，斯是用痛心疾首，暱就寡人。”

meaning.en: Not essential; one can take it or leave it.
meaning.zh: 有没有都可以，形容不重要。

examples.zh: 这些装饰可有可无。
examples.en: These decorations are neither here nor there.

examples.zh: 别觉得自己在团队里可有可无。
examples.en: Don't think you're dispensable in the team.

examples.zh: 文章里可有可无的话都删掉。
examples.en: Cut anything from the essay that isn't essential.

synonyms: 大年三十晚上打兔子——有你不多，没你不少
曹操吃鸡肋——食之无味，弃之可惜

meaning.en: To break a whole into small parts, e.g. splitting a force into small units.
meaning.zh: 把整体分成许多零散的部分。

examples.zh: 游击队化整为零，分散突围。
examples.en: The guerrillas split into small groups and broke out separately.

examples.zh: 把大任务化整为零，就不觉得难了。
examples.en: Break a big task into small parts and it won't seem so daunting.

examples.zh: 为了逃税，他们把收入化整为零。
examples.en: To evade tax, they split their income into small amounts.

meaning.en: Quiet and taciturn.
meaning.zh: 不声不响，很少说话。

examples.zh: 他平时沉默寡言，关键时刻却很有主见。
examples.en: He's normally a man of few words, but decisive when it counts.

examples.zh: 自从父亲去世，她变得沉默寡言。
examples.en: Since her father died she's become withdrawn and quiet.

examples.zh: 那个沉默寡言的男孩成绩最好。
examples.en: The quiet boy got the best results.

meaning.en: Competing to catch up with and overtake each other.
meaning.zh: 你追赶我，我追赶你，形容竞争激烈、互相追赶。

examples.zh: 班里形成了你追我赶的学习氛围。
examples.en: The class developed a spirit of friendly rivalry in their studies.

examples.zh: 两队比分你追我赶，比赛十分激烈。
examples.en: The score see-sawed between the teams in a gripping match.

examples.zh: 各地经济发展你追我赶。
examples.en: Regions are racing each other to grow their economies.

meaning.en: To take something in passing; to pilfer when the chance arises.
meaning.zh: 顺手把别人的羊牵走，比喻趁机拿走别人的东西。

examples.zh: 酒店的毛巾常被客人顺手牵羊。
examples.en: Guests often walk off with hotel towels.

examples.zh: 他在超市顺手牵羊，被保安抓住了。
examples.en: He was caught by security for pocketing goods at the supermarket.

examples.zh: 开会时我的笔被谁顺手牵羊拿走了。
examples.en: Someone walked off with my pen during the meeting.

usage.en: Predicate. Stratagem 12 of the Thirty-Six Stratagems: exploit any small opportunity.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。为“三十六计”第十二计。

meaning.en: To get gradually better or more enjoyable.
meaning.zh: 逐渐进入美好的境地，指情况越来越好或兴味越来越浓。

examples.zh: 下半场，他的状态渐入佳境。
examples.en: In the second half he really found his stride.

examples.zh: 这部剧前几集一般，后面渐入佳境。
examples.en: The first few episodes are so-so, but it gets better and better.

examples.zh: 两人的关系渐入佳境。
examples.en: Their relationship is going from strength to strength.

meaning.en: To let something run its course without intervening.
meaning.zh: 听凭它去，不加过问。

examples.zh: 对孩子的坏习惯不能听之任之。
examples.en: You can't just let a child's bad habits slide.

examples.zh: 面对违规行为，有关部门却听之任之。
examples.en: The authorities turned a blind eye to the violations.

usage.en: Predicate; usually negative (不能听之任之).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“不能听之任之”。

meaning.en: To let oneself be captured without resistance.
meaning.zh: 捆起手来让人捉住，指不抵抗而被捉。

examples.zh: 在警方的包围下，嫌犯只好束手就擒。
examples.en: Surrounded by police, the suspect had no choice but to give himself up.

examples.zh: 我们绝不会束手就擒。
examples.en: We will never surrender without a fight.

meaning.en: Wholly focused, without distraction.
meaning.zh: 心思集中，没有别的追求或杂念。

examples.zh: 她心无旁骛地准备高考。
examples.en: She prepared for the gaokao with total focus.

examples.zh: 只有心无旁骛，才能把技术练到极致。
examples.en: Only total concentration will take your skills to the top.

examples.zh: 科学家心无旁骛地投入研究。
examples.en: The scientist devoted herself single-mindedly to research.

meaning.en: As a precaution against the unlikely.
meaning.zh: 用来防备可能出现的意外情况。

equivalents: to be on the safe side

examples.zh: 带上雨伞，以防万一。
examples.en: Take an umbrella, just in case.

examples.zh: 以防万一，重要文件要备份。
examples.en: Back up important files, to be on the safe side.

examples.zh: 我多订了一间房，以防万一。
examples.en: I booked an extra room in case.

usage.en: Purpose clause, at start or end of a sentence.
usage.zh: 多作目的状语，放在句首或句末。

meaning.en: So forceful as to make even the deaf hear; awakening the complacent.
meaning.zh: 声音很大，使耳聋的人也听得见，比喻用言论唤醒糊涂麻木的人。

examples.zh: 他的文章振聋发聩，引起了社会的广泛关注。
examples.en: His article was a wake-up call that drew wide public attention.

examples.zh: 这番话振聋发聩，让人深思。
examples.en: These words were truly eye-opening and gave people food for thought.

meaning.en: Forgivable given the circumstances.
meaning.zh: 按情理有可以原谅的地方。

examples.zh: 他第一次犯错，情有可原。
examples.en: It's his first mistake, so it's forgivable.

examples.zh: 迟到是因为堵车，情有可原。
examples.en: Being late because of traffic is understandable.

examples.zh: 虽然情有可原，但规矩还是要遵守。
examples.en: Mitigating circumstances or not, rules are rules.

meaning.en: To do all one can.
meaning.zh: 用全部力量去做。

examples.zh: 这件事我不能保证成功，但一定尽力而为。
examples.en: I can't promise success, but I'll do my best.

examples.zh: 比赛结果不重要，尽力而为就好。
examples.en: The result doesn't matter; just give it your all.

examples.zh: 我们会尽力而为，帮您找到行李。
examples.en: We'll do everything we can to find your luggage.

usage.en: Predicate; often paired with 量力而行.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“量力而行”连用。
